Name: Rename Mayo to Custard (CP)
Author: SSyl
Description:
[b][u][size=5]Now Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6![/size][/u][/b]

This mod pretty much only exists because my wife absolutely hates mayonnaise, but still wanted to use eggs to make artisanal goods.

I figured I'd throw this mod on here in case anyone else didn't like mayo as much as my wife.

Currently it's only in English, but anyone can feel free to translate it to their own languages.

[b]Requirements:
[/b]
This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.

[b]Compatibility:

[/b]Should be compatible with everything Content Patcher is compatible with. I've been using it with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, and Canon Friendly Dialog Expansion for several in-game years without any issues.

Downloads.Description: Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6 and latest Content Patcher (2.3.0).
